detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Oxytocin

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C43H66N12O12S2
  • Molecular Weight: 1007.19 g/mol
  • Sequence: CYIQNCPLG-NH2
  • Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Oxytocin is a synthetic peptide corresponding to a sequence found in endogenous neuropeptide systems. It is utilized in laboratory research involving peptide structure and interaction analysis under controlled experimental conditions. This material is supplied in lyophilized powder form and is intended strictly for controlled in vitro research and analytical applications.

Research Applications:

Oxytocin is utilized in controlled research environments to support investigation of:

  • Peptide–receptor interaction dynamics in neuroendocrine signaling models
  • Ligand binding and receptor affinity characterization
  • Intracellular signaling cascade analysis associated with peptide ligands
  • Structure-function relationships of peptide sequences in controlled systems
  • Stability, degradation, and analytical profiling in assay-based environments

All research applications are conducted in non-human, non-clinical experimental settings.

Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized material at −20°C (−4°F)
  • After reconstitution, store at 2–8°C (36–46°F) and use promptly
  • Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles
  • Maintain aseptic laboratory handling procedures
  • Purchaser is responsible for appropriate handling in accordance with institutional research protocols
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Oxytocin is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
